Here are the Quarrendon Freight Lines (QFL) ticket numbers I found in Moss's digests:

1. **#4419**: Source is Moss's undated North cheat sheet (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). It says Thea Ramaswell logged #4419 for gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The same note says it was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing.
2. **#PD-4492**: Source is Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" from 5 Oct 2025 (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea submitted it on 4 Oct 2025 for gatehouse kiosk SMS bay assignments not reaching drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Doors 14–18). A patch went in that evening, and the 04:00 shift cleared on 5 Oct. The same note has an action to review it before the 14 Oct maintenance window.

Two things to be aware of:

- Marcus Lindqvist's Q2 expansion wrap (14 Jul 2025, `members/marcus-lindqvist/notes/`) also cites **#4419**, but describes it as "Gate 3 printer lag" rather than the Door 14 scanner issue. That note isn't Moss's, so I've listed it only as a conflict. Someone should confirm which description is right before the weekly notes go out.
- I left out #4409 and #4412. They appear in Moss's Central handoffs digest, but they belong to a Central account (Pree's dealer account, Salina North yard), not QFL.

I also checked the GBrain index first. It's running keyword-only, so it may miss some notes. I verified the ticket references against the files directly. I haven't written anything to the weekly notes yet. If you want, I can post this list there or send it to Ruth.
